questions.question: What question does Psalm 15 ask?
options: O LORD, what is man that you care for him?
O LORD, how long will you hide your face?
O LORD, who shall dwell on your holy hill?
O LORD, who can stand when you appear?
questions.answer: O LORD, who shall dwell on your holy hill?

questions.question: What kind of person may dwell with God?
options: The one who brings to him the very costliest of sacrifices
The one who is exceedingly rich and gives freely to the poor
The one who walks blamelessly and speaks truth in his heart
The one who is strong and mighty and skilled in battle
questions.answer: The one who walks blamelessly and speaks truth in his heart

questions.question: The blameless person swears to his own hurt and does not change.
He who does these things will never be _____.
He does not put out his money at _____ or take a bribe.
